text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, now I've done it... After I warmed
up and
everything!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No! Not much, at least. The injury itself
is only
minor...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid of getting out of shape, so I
really want
to get back to training, but...
Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Okay, Trainer... Time for a pop quiz!
Ready?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Which of the following is our best course
of
action right now?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
One: do some light running. Two: do a
casual
workout. Three: do some water
aerobics to avoid
muscle strain!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! That's cheating! There is no
number four!
choice_data_list: ……わかった、練習再開を目指そう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to her that there is some logic
to what
she's saying, but that I think
she'd benefit much
more from a
thorough rest.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see. Well, if that's your reasoning, I
accept.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit of an emotional blow... but I'll
take a
nice long rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so Fine Motion does as I
recommend and
prioritizes rest and
recuperation.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! ♪ When it comes to small
injuries, it's
best to get your body
moving, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I think... I might have misjudged things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion smiles through her
disappointment
and commits to getting
the recuperation she
needs.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Okay, shall we head right to the training
track,
then? ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
See, I told you exercise was for the
best. ♪ Let's
keep this up within reason!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fine Motion eases herself back
into
training.
